name: πMorpH
author: Timo
summary: Polyphonic XY wavetable synthesizer with paths, orbit, dual envelopes, HP/LP filters, two LFOs and an eight-slot modulation matrix. Includes 100 presets plus INIT and Custom Wavetable import: mono/stereo PCM16, PCM32 or float32 WAV, 512/1024/2048 samples per waveform.
